INSUFFICIENCY_CERTIFICATE_20261113 closed the vocabulary to 31 facts and found the obstacle 'moved from representation to combinatorics': 8,388,608 hypotheses against a learner cap of 12. Measured here on nine real actions, 36 real states and 17 real facts (486 executions): identification never enumerates that space. One success plus the two nearest refusals -- the charitable form of 'experience each action once' -- leaves 4,096-16,384 survivors that agree on nothing off-sample (6-12 of 12 held-out states undecided, set accuracy 0.000-0.333). Adding VARIED successes collapses them to 2-4 and is exact on held-out for 6 of 9 actions in at most 24 executions, because only a success in which a fact is FALSE can eliminate the superset -- so a success is the irrelevance evidence, correcting the previous round's 'a success teaches nothing'. The three residue cases are named, one of them (tar_x) for an UNSOUND column: its fact is computed by tar -tzf, which returns 0 for a gzip of garbage. Confident error: zero; the failure mode is abstention, which is the only safe one. n=17 costs 131,072 subsets and 129,140,163 conjunctions, and nothing enumerates either.

truth.how_the_frontier_actually_handles_this: Frontier coding agents do not arbitrate their own tools by consensus either: they run the command and read its exit status and diff, which is conformance, and the check that matters is whether the run did what was asked. Multi-reader schemes in the literature are used to surface conflicts for escalation, not to overwrite an outcome that already executed -- exactly the distinction this round measures.
truth.the_law_this_round_adds: A fact is a prediction of the action it gates, not a description of the world. Its correctness is conformance to that action's outcome, and no amount of reader agreement can override the outcome. Two free readers are worth reading because they locate the doubt; they are the wrong thing to ask for the verdict.
